name: Aqua-Terrarium 80x45x50x30
label: Large terrarium
lead: Combined aqua-terrarium measuring 80x45x50 cm. Ideal for animals that need both a land and a water section in their habitat. Water section height: 30 cm.

description.html: Of this aqua-terrarium's total 50 cm of height, 30 cm is the water section, and the remaining 20 cm is left for land and equipment. The floor is 80x45 cm, so water filled to 30 cm comes to about 108 liters. That is a volume in which a filter keeps the water clean more easily than in smaller models.

The 20 cm of free space above the water allows the island to be raised and completely dry while the lamp still stays at a safe distance from the animal. A young Chinese water dragon uses that height for a branch above the water, and turtles use it for basking. A total volume of 180 liters and more than 100 kg of water call for a stable stand on the floor.
A ratio of 30 cm of water and 20 cm of air above it suits these species:

items: Amphibians that need an aquatic section

description.html: If you want more air space for branches, we build the same model taller, and if you keep only turtles, it can also be lower with the same water section. The next size up in our range is the 100x45x45 with a 3D background. We pack the ordered aqua-terrarium and ship it by courier throughout Serbia. A custom variant takes us 7 to 14 days, depending on size and background.
